active_constraints.constraint_text: Before taking any action that writes to or modifies the database (create, confirm, cancel, update), list the full action details and obtain explicit user confirmation before proceeding.
Do not fabricate or invent any information — prices, quantities, statuses, IDs — not directly returned by tools or stated by the user.

Verify the identity of the target entity (customer, employee, vendor, product) before taking any action on their behalf. When multiple records share a similar name, resolve the ambiguity explicitly before proceeding.
Transfer to a human agent only if the request falls outside the scope of your available tools and policies.
Always confirm the exact product variant and customer identity before processing any order.
Do not process orders that exceed the customer's credit limit.
Orders above $2,000 require manager approval before confirmation.
New customers start with a $1,000 credit limit. Orders over $500 for new customers require a credit check before proceeding.
Do not access or modify any employee records within the sales workflow.
